summary: The completed 14:00 UTC BTC interval normalized after the prior 13:00 UTC joint range-and-turnover burst. Bybit spot range/volume robust z-scores fell to +0.8147/+1.6615; Bybit linear to +0.6453/+1.2954; Twelve Data range to +0.8310. This bounds the prior anomaly to one hour and rejects continuous high-volatility/turnover persistence at this checkpoint. Licensed NQZ6/GCZ6/SIZ6 hourly aggregates remained stale to 07:00 UTC, so contemporaneous cross-market propagation remains unverified.

evidence.limitation: Point snapshot only; no historical-depth, persistent-liquidity, aggressor-flow, absorption, or execution-quality inference is made.

evidence.finding: All three direct futures series ended at 07:00 UTC, more than eight hours before retrieval, and were excluded from contemporaneous inference.

The prior BTC joint range-and-turnover burst was discrete and normalized in the next completed hour across independent price representations. This does not establish cause, liquidation activity, directional order flow, liquidity recovery, or broad cross-market propagation.

conflicts: The 15:00 UTC BTC bar was still forming at retrieval and was excluded.
Direct NQZ6, GCZ6, and SIZ6 aggregates were stale to 07:00 UTC and cannot confirm or falsify contemporaneous cross-market behavior at 14:00 UTC.
limitations: No authenticated historical trade-sign or depth sequence, open interest, liquidations, funding, basis, DXY, Treasury/rates, or volatility-index evidence was acquired.
Bybit spot and linear volume fields remain representation-specific and were not fused.
Robust z-scores use median/MAD over the prior 28 completed hourly bars and are descriptive, not causal.
next_decisive_check: Require current direct NQ/GC/SI plus USD/rates/volatility evidence and test whether BTC remains normalized through the next completed hour; only renewed multi-representation expansion would reopen the persistence hypothesis.

argus.finding: Authenticated Bybit spot and linear candle ranges and representation-specific volumes normalized immediately after the prior joint burst, bounding the execution-physics anomaly to one hour without inferring directional flow or liquidity recovery.

nexus.finding: Bybit spot, Bybit linear, and Twelve Data independently reconciled on normalization with preserved clocks; direct futures source health remained degraded because aggregates stopped at 07:00 UTC.
